metadata.title: German A1 Vocabulary Dataset
metadata.selectionNote: A balanced pedagogical selection across all 18 Goethe Deutsch Online A1 course chapters. Rank reflects learning priority and source-course order, not a universal corpus-frequency claim.
metadata.contentNote: English glosses and lexical forms were normalized from public Goethe A1 reference material. Example sentences, metadata, exercise settings, and morphology enrichment were generated for this application and require editorial review before a production release.

sourceReferences.name: Goethe-Institut Deutsch Online A1 Glossary, Chapters 1–18
sourceReferences.purpose: A1 lexical inventory, English glosses, noun article/plural notation, and topic sequencing
